notCovered.label: Flora (Line A)

notCovered.label: Line D

stations: 57 metro stations (Flora excluded - no scheduled service, see notCovered).
notes: Muzeum is the inner-city hub where lines A and C cross; it never appears as a direction. No single station serves all three lines — Můstek (A x B) and Florenc (B x C) are the other two interchanges, each a separate stop from Muzeum. Flora isn't shown because Metro Line A currently runs no scheduled service there (confirmed against both the static timetable and the live feed) — use Jiřího z Poděbrad or Želivského instead.
